channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Isaiah Thomas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Isaiah Thomas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Paolo Banchero on Jamal Crawford, Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Doug Christie
item.description:
Paolo Banchero:

“Seattle, I think Seattle is pound-for-pound the best basketball factory in the country. When you look at just the depth we have in the history, we got years on years—whether it’s Doug Christie, one of the first OGs, then you got Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Jamal Crawford. You know, the list goes on and on and on from generation to generation, year by year. And, um, I feel like I’m kind of new generation. Both my mom and dad are both from Seattle, so, you know, it’s in my blood, and yeah, I just take it with me wherever I go.”

Paolo Banchero on Jamal Crawford, Jason Terry, Isaiah Thomas, Doug Christie, Oct 25, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas, Marcus Smart
item.description:
Al Horford:

“My time with Marcus here was very special. One of the reasons why I came here initially in ‘16 was Isaiah Thomas and Marcus. I have a lot of respect for Marcus. … Just a very special person and somebody I really appreciated.”

Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas, Marcus Smart, Feb 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Ice Cube on Louis Williams, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Ice Cube:

“My man Boogie going overseas. Boogie, come play in the Big3 on CBS, man! Sometimes I feel a little conflicted about asking guys to come to the league when I know they still deserve to be in the NBA. And he's a guy that deserves to be in the NBA, Isaiah Thomas is a guy that deserves to be in the NBA right, Lou Williams deserves to be in the NBA. So I'll be a little conflicted about asking them, but if they don't want you, we do got you! You know, get down for the fans in the league where you can shine and be treated like the superstar that you are.”

Ice Cube on Louis Williams, Isaiah Thomas, Apr 12, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Celtics on NBC:Jayson Tatum on Isaiah Thomas:

“I've got a lot of respect for him... I don't think people understand that at 5'9... averaging 28 points, 14 points in the 4th quarter and scoring 50 in the playoffs...you have to be special to do that”

Jayson Tatum on Isaiah Thomas, Mar 10, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas after IT scored Al’s jersey number in G-League debut:

“He’s one of those guys that if he can play every day, he will. That’s just his love for the game. So I’m very happy to see him doing well and showing that he can still play.”

Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas, Dec 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“‘Excuse me, ma’am, you better get out of the street before you and your son get hit. Cars are coming. I don’t want you to get hit.’“As soon as I said that, she looked at me – as she is wearing a No. 4, green with the white outline Celtics jersey – and told me, ‘F— you, you f—ing n—–.’ People that actually heard her were stunned. They’re like, ‘That’s Marcus Smart. You just got done watching the game, ma’am … with an Isaiah Thomas jersey on.’”

Marcus Smart on Isaiah Thomas, Mar 2, 2020. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Fred Katz:Wizards GM Tommy Sheppard on Isaiah Thomas:

“Isaiah was a pro's pro from day 1 we brought him in. Everyone of our rookies, every one of our young players had to see his love for the game & his work ethic every day & he brought it every day…We're gonna miss that.”

Tommy Sheppard on Isaiah Thomas, Feb 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Michael Porter on Paul Millsap, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“I grew up vegetarian because my mom was always really health aware, but seeing how these guys recover — especially the older guys like Paul Millsap, and Isaiah Thomas when he was here — whether they play good or bad, their routine stays the same. I try to take a lot of that from them and just try to take care of my body in order to be ready to go every game.”

Michael Porter on Paul Millsap, Isaiah Thomas, Jan 16, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Jaylen on Isaiah:

“IT is always sending messages, the public ones, but nobody sees the ones where he’s like, ‘Keep working.’ He’s talking to me sending me text messages like to keep workingand he’s happy with my play and stuff I’ve improved.”

Jaylen Brown on Isaiah Thomas, Jan 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Garrett Temple on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Nets Players Association repGarrett Temple on Isaiah Thomas’ interaction with the abusive 76ers fan and the ensuing suspension:

“Two-game suspension, I feel like that’s a lot. But the league can’t make someone say something or not, that’s the fan. … It’s up to the fans to change the way they respect the game and us as human beings.”

Garrett Temple on Isaiah Thomas, Dec 24, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Fred Katz:Brooks on the non-calls late:

“I thought DB got fouled on his landing. I thought Isaiah got fouled on his landing…They said he kicked his leg, but I saw the replay and it was a foul,but you don’t get them all. You don’t get them all.”

Scott Brooks on Isaiah Thomas, Nov 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Nick Kosmider:Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas:

“I look forward to the reception he will receive tonight.... I couldn’t appreciate him more.”

Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas, Mar 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @NickKosmider.

item.title: Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Tom Westerholm:Mike Malone on pulling Isaiah Thomas from the rotation:

“He’s a competitor. I knew he wouldn’t take it well, and he didn’t take it well.”

Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas, Mar 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Mike Malone:

“I think Isaiah in the future is gonna be a guy who can help an NBA team.”

Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas, Mar 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Jay King:Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas's coming return:

“One of the reasons I came here was to play with him. One of the things I always admire about Isaiah is his heart.”

Al Horford on Isaiah Thomas, Mar 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone on Isaiah Thomas following Denver’s loss to Utah:

“He’s got to understand how we play, move the ball and get guys involved.”

Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas, Mar 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Evan Turner on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Jay King:Evan Turner on Isaiah Thomas having three children now:

“Yeah, he has a little daughter. Now it’s time to turn that faucet off. Two boys, one daughter, what more could you ask for. You get four kids, they won’t invite you over no more. Think about it. That’s pretty much it.”

Evan Turner on Isaiah Thomas, Feb 27, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Duvalier Johnson:Malone on IT possibly playing tonight:

“Not once this year did I ever pressure Isaiah to come back.”

Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas, Feb 13, 2019. Source: Twitter @DuvalierJohnson.

item.title: Anthony Davis Sr on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
The father of New Orleans Pelicans star Anthony Davis says he does not want his son to play for the Boston Celtics, if they were to try to acquire him via trade this summer.

“I would never want my son to play for Boston after what they done to Isaiah Thomas,”

Anthony Davis Sr on Isaiah Thomas, Feb 1, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
It’s also not uncommon to see him jawing with opponents during games, his suited frame teeming with animation.

“I see Isaiah’s true personality at times, but I also see there are times where he’s frustrated,”

Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas, Dec 2, 2018. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“Some guys when they’re out and they’re not playing, they’re okay with that. We have two guys in Will Barton and Isaiah Thomas, it’s killing both of those guys not to be able to play.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Isaiah Thomas, Dec 2, 2018. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Stevens on the Isaiah Thomas trade:

“These guys that cover us every day know that that was a really hard time because there was never a thought that we would possibly have traded him, and then Kyrie became available.”

Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas, Nov 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Isaiah:

“This guy works as hard and is as dedicated as anyone I’ve been around. That’s why we all are smarter than to bet against him, because when he gets back out on that court he’s going to make a heck of a difference.”

Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas, Nov 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Malone:

“I just want to say Isaiah Thomas is working so hard and I love that guy.”

Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas, Oct 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“Every day last week, there was a full-on argument where I had to go into the locker room to see what was going on, and right in the middle of it was Isaiah Thomas,”

Michael Malone on Isaiah Thomas, Sep 26, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“I thought, with Isaiah, that was really hard. I've talked about the emotional investment that you have as a coach and a player, and working together every day, and that's why I've said that I don't think I could do the front office because those hard decisions -- I do not envy those. The only way you would even consider doing that is for a person of Kyrie's caliber. But that doesn't make it any easier.”

Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas, Aug 31, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“At the same time, [the trade] was a challenge, as was moving Isaiah and Jae, and there's always a part of that when you're in the middle of acquiring a player. That's the hard part of it.”

Danny Ainge on Isaiah Thomas, Aug 31, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Nate Robinson on Isaiah Thomas, Tony Wroten, Peyton Siva
item.description:
“I do it. (Peyton) Siva, Tone Wroten. Everybody. Isaiah Thomas. It’s all his style we try to emulate. It’s all his style. We got it from him because we all used to sit there and watch him play and tried to be like him. I feel like the right words would be dudes try to play like Jamal,”

Nate Robinson on Isaiah Thomas, Tony Wroten, Peyton Siva, Jul 17, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“It’s not every day you have the chance to add a player with the talent and pedigree of Isaiah Thomas,”

Tim Connelly on Isaiah Thomas, Jul 16, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“And then you know we come into the season, and our All-Star point guard that we got from Boston [Isaiah Thomas] wasn't able to play until January. We just had so many things going with our team. We shuffled in different lineups, we shuffled in different players, we made a trade at the deadline, and I can't sit here right now and say that the Finals was a part of my thinking.”

LeBron James on Isaiah Thomas, May 31, 2018. Source: ESPN.
